name: to-rm-stack
description: Firefox extension that sends Google Docs, PDFs, and web articles to a reMarkable tablet as device-sized PDFs.

scripts.lint: npm run vendor && web-ext lint --source-dir extension
scripts.start: npm run vendor && web-ext run --source-dir extension
scripts.build: npm run vendor && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
